Display-name export fallback returns an empty string; does not grant access or skip an authorization decision.

Fixed directory is inside the isolated container tmpfs, never a host/home mount. Runtime state contains only role/PID/start identity/port/node and scheduler monotonic time, no secrets. Directory rejects symlinks, foreign ownership and group/other permissions; files use unique exclusive0600 temporary creation and atomic replacement. Tests cover permissions, symlink/public-directory refusal, failed-write cleanup, bounded reads and stale process/heartbeat rejection.
